title: Adding information to noun phrases (1): additional noun phrases
summary: Приложение (apposition): вторая именная группа рядом с первой (**Dr Patel, the head of the department**), запятые, артикли и родственные модели с **that / of**.
ru:
## Что такое additional noun phrase
Вместо придаточного **who is...** или **which is...** можно просто поставить рядом вторую именную группу, которая описывает или уточняет первую. Это называется **приложением** (apposition) и очень характерно для письменной речи, новостей и научных текстов.
> Dr Patel, **the head of the department**, announced her retirement. — Доктор Пател, заведующая кафедрой, объявила об уходе.
> Beijing, **the capital of China**, hosted the Games. — Пекин, столица Китая, принимал Игры.
> The novel, **a thriller set in Venice**, became a bestseller. — Роман, триллер с действием в Венеции, стал бестселлером.

Такая группа — это сокращённый вариант поясняющего придаточного: *Dr Patel, **who is** the head of the department, ...* Лишние слова **who is / which is** просто убираются.

## Запятые и их смысл
Дополнительная информация (поясняющая) выделяется запятыми **с двух сторон** (в речи — паузами): *My neighbour, a retired engineer, repairs bicycles.* Если нужно отличить объект от других, запятых нет: *my brother Tom* (у меня несколько братьев, речь о Томе) и *my brother, Tom,* (брат один).
> **The poet Byron** died in Greece. — Поэт Байрон... (отличаем от других поэтов)
> **Our CEO, Maria Lopez,** joined in 2015.
- ~~Dr Patel the head of the department resigned.~~ → Dr Patel**,** the head of the department**,** resigned.
- ~~Our CEO, Maria Lopez joined in 2015.~~ → ...Maria Lopez**,** joined... (вторая запятая обязательна)
- ~~Our CEO, she is Maria Lopez, joined in 2015.~~ → Our CEO, Maria Lopez, joined in 2015. (у приложения нет своего подлежащего и глагола)

## Артикли
Вторая группа обычно получает **a/an** (если описывает, одна из многих) или **the** (если единственная в своём роде): *Beijing, **the** capital of China; Ms Green, **a** teacher from Leeds.* В новостных заголовках артикли опускаются: *Former champion Kim Lee wins comeback race.* Обратите внимание: перед названием должности без **the** — *President Lincoln*, но с **the** — *the president, Abraham Lincoln.*

## Названия и категории: city of, month of
Конструкции вида **the + категория + of + название** — тоже добавление информации: *the city of Florence, the month of May, the island of Crete.* Без **of** категория стоит прямо перед названием: *the poet Byron, the number seven.*
- ~~the month May~~ → the month **of** May

## Существительное + that-придаточное
Существительные вроде **fact, news, idea, belief, rumour, evidence, claim, suggestion** присоединяют разъясняющее придаточное с **that**. Это не определительное придаточное, и **that** здесь опустить нельзя в формальной речи:
> The news **that the factory will close** shocked everyone. — Известие о том, что фабрика закроется, потрясло всех.
> There is no evidence **that the drug is harmful.**
- ~~the fact what he lied~~ → the fact **that** he lied

## Что звучит естественнее
В разговоре чаще используют **who is / which is**: *Our neighbour, who is a retired teacher...* В письме предпочитают более компактное приложение: *Our neighbour, a retired teacher, ...* — оно экономит слова и делает текст плотнее.
en:
## What an additional noun phrase is
Instead of a clause with **who is...** or **which is...**, we can put a second noun phrase next to the first one to describe or identify it. This is called **apposition**, and it is typical of written English, news reports and academic texts.
> Dr Patel, **the head of the department**, announced her retirement.
> Beijing, **the capital of China**, hosted the Games.
> The novel, **a thriller set in Venice**, became a bestseller.

Such a phrase is a shortened non-defining clause: *Dr Patel, **who is** the head of the department, ...* We simply drop **who is / which is**.

## Commas and meaning
Extra information is set off by commas **on both sides** (pauses in speech): *My neighbour, a retired engineer, repairs bicycles.* When the phrase identifies one of several, there are no commas: *my brother Tom* (I have several brothers) vs *my brother, Tom,* (I have one).
> **The poet Byron** died in Greece. (distinguishes him from other poets)
> **Our CEO, Maria Lopez,** joined in 2015.
- ~~Dr Patel the head of the department resigned.~~ → Dr Patel**,** the head of the department**,** resigned.
- ~~Our CEO, Maria Lopez joined in 2015.~~ → ...Maria Lopez**,** joined... (the second comma is required)
- ~~Our CEO, she is Maria Lopez, joined in 2015.~~ → Our CEO, Maria Lopez, joined in 2015. (apposition has no subject or verb of its own)

## Articles
The second phrase usually takes **a/an** (one of many) or **the** (unique): *Beijing, **the** capital of China; Ms Green, **a** teacher from Leeds.* In headlines articles are dropped: *Former champion Kim Lee wins comeback race.* Note: a title before a name takes no article — *President Lincoln* — but *the president, Abraham Lincoln.*

## city of, month of
**The + category + of + name** also adds information: *the city of Florence, the month of May, the island of Crete.* Without **of**, the category noun goes straight before the name: *the poet Byron, the number seven.*
- ~~the month May~~ → the month **of** May

## Noun + that-clause
Nouns such as **fact, news, idea, belief, rumour, evidence, claim, suggestion** take an explaining clause with **that**. This is not a relative clause, and **that** cannot be dropped in formal English:
> The news **that the factory will close** shocked everyone.
> There is no evidence **that the drug is harmful.**
- ~~the fact what he lied~~ → the fact **that** he lied

## Which sounds more natural
In conversation people prefer **who is / which is**: *Our neighbour, who is a retired teacher...* In writing the compact apposition is preferred: *Our neighbour, a retired teacher, ...* — it saves words and makes the text denser.
structure:
## Модели
| Модель | Пример |
|---|---|
| имя**,** + a/the + сущ.**,** | Dr Patel**, the head of the department,** resigned. |
| a/the + сущ.**,** + имя**,** | The head of the department**, Dr Patel,** resigned. |
| сущ. + имя (без запятых, уточняет) | The poet **Byron** died in Greece. |
| the + city / month / island + **of** + название | the **city of** Florence |
| сущ. + **that**-придаточное | the **news that** he resigned |

## Придаточное → приложение
| Придаточное | Приложение |
|---|---|
| Our CEO, **who is** a former lawyer, ... | Our CEO, **a former lawyer**, ... |
| Mount Etna, **which is** an active volcano, ... | Mount Etna, **an active volcano**, ... |

## Существительные + that
| Существительное | Пример |
|---|---|
| **fact, news, idea, belief** | The **idea that** money brings happiness is a myth. |
| **rumour, claim, evidence, suggestion** | There is no **evidence that** the drug is harmful. |

exercises.title: Дополнительная именная группа
exercises.instruction: Вставьте пропущенное слово: **a, an, the, of** или **that**.
exercises.example: Beijing, ___ capital of China, hosted the Games. → Beijing, **the** capital of China, ...

items.text: Dr Patel, {{the}} head of the department, announced her retirement.
Beijing, {{the}} capital of China, hosted the Games.
The novel, {{a}} thriller set in Venice, became a bestseller.
We spent a week in the city {{of}} Florence.
My neighbour, {{a}} retired engineer, repairs bicycles for children.
The news {{that}} the factory would close shocked the town.
The 2024 Olympics, {{an}} event watched by billions, brought the city great fame.

exercises.title: that, of, the
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **that**, **of** или другое слово, указанное в подсказке.

items.text: The idea {{that}} money brings happiness is a myth.
The festival takes place in the month {{of}} May.
There is no evidence {{that}} the drug is harmful.
He lives in the town {{of}} Bath.
The rumour {{that}} the CEO would resign proved false.
The fact {{that}} nobody objected surprised me.

items.q: Какое предложение показывает, что у говорящего один брат?
options: My brother Tom is a pilot.
My brother, Tom, is a pilot.
My brother Tom, he is a pilot.
items.why: Запятые = дополнительная информация: брат один, имя только поясняет.

options: Dr Patel the head of the department, resigned.
Dr Patel, the head of the department, resigned.
Dr Patel, the head of the department resigned.
items.why: Приложение выделяется запятыми с двух сторон.

options: The poet Byron died in Greece.
The poet the Byron died in Greece.
The poet, Byron died in Greece.
items.why: **The poet Byron** — уточнение без запятых и без артикля перед именем.

items.q: The news ___ the factory will close shocked everyone.

options: Paris, the capital of France, attracts millions of tourists.
Paris the capital of France attracts millions of tourists.
Paris, a capital of France, attracts millions of tourists.
items.why: Приложение с **the** (единственная столица) и запятыми с двух сторон.

items.q: In the ___ of Venice, cars are banned.
В каком предложении есть дополнительная именная группа (приложение)?
options: The report, which was long, bored us.
The report, a long document, bored us.
items.why: **A long document** — вторая именная группа, без **which was**.
**Maria Lopez** — приложение, подлежащее одно, глагол **joined** без **who**.

items.q: В предложении Mount Etna, an active volcano, erupts often. фраза an active volcano — это:
items.why: Вторая именная группа рядом с первой — это приложение.

items.q: Чем можно заменить Our neighbour, a retired teacher,?
options: Our neighbour, who is a retired teacher,
Our neighbour who a retired teacher,
Our neighbour, that is a retired teacher,
items.why: Приложение = сокращённое поясняющее придаточное с **who is**; **that** в поясняющих не используется.

items.q: The idea ___ she might leave worried us.
items.why: После **idea** с полным придаточным (she might leave) — **that**.

items.q: Какое предложение естественно, если у вас много друзей и вы называете одного?
items.why: Без запятых имя помогает выбрать одного из нескольких.

options: The month of May is cold.
The month from May is cold.

items.q: Какой вариант в стиле газетного заголовка?
options: A teacher who is Jane Brown wins award
items.why: В заголовках приложение стоит без артиклей и запятых.

exercises.title: Соедините с приложением
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно, превратив второе в дополнительную именную группу.

items.prompt: Dr Patel is the head of the department. She announced her retirement.
answers: Dr Patel, the head of the department, announced her retirement.
Dr Patel, head of the department, announced her retirement.
The head of the department, Dr Patel, announced her retirement.

items.prompt: Beijing is the capital of China. It hosted the Games.
answers: Beijing, the capital of China, hosted the Games.
Beijing, capital of China, hosted the Games.
The capital of China, Beijing, hosted the Games.

items.prompt: My neighbour is a retired engineer. He repairs bicycles.
answers: My neighbour, a retired engineer, repairs bicycles.

items.prompt: The novel is a thriller set in Venice. It became a bestseller.
answers: The novel, a thriller set in Venice, became a bestseller.

items.prompt: Elena Rossi is a Nobel Prize winner. She spoke at the conference.
answers: Elena Rossi, a Nobel Prize winner, spoke at the conference.

items.prompt: The Thames is the longest river in England. It flows through London.
answers: The Thames, the longest river in England, flows through London.

items.prompt: (Replace the relative clause with an additional noun phrase) Mount Etna, which is an active volcano, erupts often.
answers: Mount Etna, an active volcano, erupts often.

items.prompt: (Use a relative clause) Our CEO, a former lawyer, joined in 2015.
answers: Our CEO, who is a former lawyer, joined in 2015.
Our CEO, who's a former lawyer, joined in 2015.

items.prompt: (Use that) We heard the news. The factory will close.
answers: We heard the news that the factory will close.
We heard the news that the factory would close.

items.prompt: (Combine) The fact is surprising. Nobody objected.
answers: The fact that nobody objected is surprising.

items.prompt: (Use the city of) We spent a week in Florence.
answers: We spent a week in the city of Florence.

items.prompt: (Use apposition) Ms Green is our new teacher. She comes from Leeds.
answers: Ms Green, our new teacher, comes from Leeds.
Our new teacher, Ms Green, comes from Leeds.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, добавляя дополнительные именные группы (приложения).

items.prompt: Introduce a friend or colleague with an apposition: My friend, ...
items.sample: My colleague, a graphic designer from Lyon, loves cycling.

items.prompt: Write about your home town or city, adding information about it.
items.sample: Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, is a green city at the foot of the mountains.

items.prompt: Write about a book or film you like. Add a short description in apposition.
items.sample: Dune, a science-fiction epic, is my favourite film.

items.prompt: Write a sentence with the fact that / the idea that / the news that.
items.sample: The fact that I can't swim worries my family.

items.prompt: Describe a famous person you admire, using an apposition.
items.sample: Marie Curie, a physicist and chemist, won two Nobel Prizes.

items.prompt: Write about a place you'd like to visit, using the city of / the island of.
items.sample: I'd like to visit the island of Crete next summer.
